calendar: Roman Republican calendar; exact historical dates are used where known, while generated simulation dates are explicitly labeled.

treasury_interest_placement_schema.qualifying_growth: realized treasury growth from operations and commerce; internal transfers excluded
treasury_interest_placement_schema.settlement: interest is not credited until the observation period ends

special_event_policy.dry_spell_adjustment: After 3 consecutive rounds without a standard special event, +2 percentage points; +4 after 4; +6 after 5+, capped at 18%. This does not affect Magnitude 11.
special_event_policy.rarity_rule: Standard Magnitudes 1-10 use the inverse-Change-Index distribution. Magnitude 11 is a separate exceptional class with a freshly randomized round-specific chance.
special_event_policy.magnitude_11_probability_rule: Each round samples a new Magnitude 11 chance uniformly from 0%-18%, then performs three independent checks at that sampled percentage.
special_event_policy.magnitude_11_dry_spell_interaction: None; Magnitude 11 chance is independently randomized each round.
special_event_policy.long_run_target: Standard special events approximately every 8-12 rounds on average; Magnitude 11 has no quota and may have long dry periods or clustered appearances.

latest_player_action: Gaius Maximus Valerius organizes all the armed men under his command, trains them personally, and spends a full day with them to demonstrate leadership and virtue.
